h:
该网站上几乎没有 DMD2 高档/细化工作流程，但都过于复杂。这是最简单的工作流程，展示了它的强大功能。我在所有图像生成结束时使用这个东西，因为它只是免费的 2-5 秒，疯狂，不仅高档，而且还对每件小事进行微妙的修复。

DMD2 劳拉 -https://huggingface.co/tianweiy/DMD2/blob/main/dmd2_sdxl_4step_lora_fp16.safetensors

在 KSampler 测试中，“start_at_step”的范围在 60-68 之间。越接近 70，对照片的影响就越小（步骤越少）。数量较少 - 更多修复（更多步骤），但也有更多您可能不喜欢的检查点干预。
输入图像尺寸应为 768-1280。更大的图像会产生像双膝盖这样的突变。

为了避免这种情况，请用强制调整大小的节点替换“高档图像”，其中最长边不大于 2048。

如果您想要更积极地提高清晰度 - 调整图像大小，请将其通过 1xReFocus upscaler，然后执行 ksampler。
https://openmodeldb.info/models/1x-ReFocus-V3

o.en:
There's few DMD2 upscale/refine workflows on this site but all are overcomplicated. Here's the essential simplest workflow presenting how powerful it is. I'm using this stuff at end of all image generation because its simply free 2-5sec, insane, not only upscale, but also subtle fix for every little thing.

DMD2 lora -https://huggingface.co/tianweiy/DMD2/blob/main/dmd2_sdxl_4step_lora_fp16.safetensors

At KSampler test with "start_at_step" in 60-68 range. Closer you get to 70 the less impact will it have on photo (less steps). Smaller number - more fixes (more steps) but also more intervention from the checkpoint that you potentially would not like.
Input image should be in 768-1280 size. Bigger images can produce mutations like double knees.

To avoid that replace "upscale image by" node with forced resize where longest side is not bigger than 2048.

If you want be more aggressive with sharpness - resize image, pass it trough 1xReFocus upscaler and then do ksampler.
https://openmodeldb.info/models/1x-ReFocus-V3
